description: Returns a LEGO set object. The reference says some response fields may be omitted depending on the set state.

parameters.name: setNumber
parameters.description: Set number to look up. Examples include 10236 and 10236-1. If a set has multiple variations, include the variation suffix such as -1.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to USD when omitted.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: BrickEconomy docs state that User-Agent is required on all requests.
